title: Delivery Workflow Event
description: Single event entry in .workflow/events.jsonl. One JSON object per line. The append-only event log is the source of truth; state.json is a derived projection.

type.description: Event type. init = workflow created. transition = top-level state change. item_transition = work-item state change. item_add = new work item. evidence = evidence recorded. note = freeform annotation. block/resume = blocked overlay. waive = guard or item waiver. abort = workflow aborted. migrate = migrated from legacy format.

item_id.description: Work item ID for item_transition and item_add events.

guard_results.description: Guard evaluation results for this transition.

evidence_keys.description: References to evidence that justifies this event.

idempotency_key.description: Hash-based key to prevent duplicate transitions. Format: workflow_id:revision:from-to.

forced.description: True if a guard was overridden by the user.

revision.description: State revision after this event was applied.

data.description: Additional structured data specific to the event type.
